title: Load needed resources during enhanced navigation
goal: Keep deliberate resource hints for pages reached by enhanced navigation.

selectionNotes: Blazor enhanced navigation; only resources actually needed.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Blazor Web App static SSR with enhanced navigation; actual execution uses RC2.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Canonical compiler mode; no C# 15-only syntax.

prerequisites: Use a static router and HeadOutlet with blazor.web.js. An interactive SPA router is not enhanced navigation. The complete standalone files, SDK pins and commands are included offline.

Author HeadContent hints only for measured destination needs. Match the exact eventual URL, fetch destination/as, MIME type, credentials/CORS and cache policy. Same-origin loopback data/module examples need no account or external provider.

.NET 10.0.13 already has the enhanced-navigation guard in SSRRenderModeBoundary, as does selected RC2. The historical guide's .NET 11 introduction is not a claim that every serviced .NET 10 emits implicit hints. The valid .NET 10 explicit pattern is a comparison, not a new foundation or older-target route.
constraints: Blazor enhanced navigation; only resources actually needed. Initial/full navigation behavior is separate. No universal preload requirement or browser request-count/performance guarantee.

Preload fetch does not consume data and modulepreload does not execute the module. Normal fetch/import still performs the work; matched cache entries may be reused. Warm cache, credential mismatches and browser scheduling affect observed requests.

HTTP is loopback authoring only. Production needs appropriate HTTPS/CORS/cache policy. Request receipts are bounded local diagnostics, not a production logging endpoint. No WASM runtime boot-preload, Server/Auto/interactive-router, other-browser/OS or GA execution claim.
stabilityLimitations: Stable HTML/Blazor APIs; selected .NET 11 framework is RC2, not GA.

evidence.scope: Actual matching SDK build; separate real browser enhanced fetch/header/document identity, hint/control resource requests, deferred module evaluation and warm-cache checks. Exact source/artifacts/payloads and installed-body reconstruction: docs/verification/PIN-800.md. No mock, cross-compilation, universal request count or GA claim.
